notice: Export completed with explicit settings. This report does not establish visual, accessibility, scientific-integrity, or journal-submission compliance.

provenance.exclusions: chips with ground floor < 800 uV (FLOOR_MIN_HUM_UV) are drawn in grey and excluded from inference; animals the pipeline did not accept are dashed
provenance.n: per mouse; no averaging across animals. Only B2 is judgeable and accepted on both days.
transformations: 4 s epochs; states from stage3 (Otsu split of log EMG rms per animal, then theta/delta split of non-wake)
hourly bins = 900 epochs, no smoothing or interpolation
SWA = mean 1-4 Hz power within NREM epochs, normalised per animal to its own ZT0-1 mean
provenance.uncertainty: none plotted: epochs within an animal are strongly autocorrelated, so a binomial or bootstrap interval over epochs would be anticonservative and is not shown
